run_stable_diffusion_upscale: run the GaudiStableDiffusionUpscalePipeline to upscale a low-res image using text-guided Stable Diffusion on HPU
prepare_latents_for_upscale: prepare random noise latents scaled by the scheduler init noise sigma for image super-resolution
split_inputs_into_batches: split latents, text embeddings, images, and noise levels into HPU-optimized batches with padding for the last batch
run_unet_on_hpu: run the UNet forward pass on HPU with optional HPU graph capture and replay caching for faster inference
capture_replay_hpu_graph: capture a UNet computation graph on HPU, cache it by input hash, and replay with new inputs for accelerated denoising
